-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/copyshadow

go 1.27

-- w/scanlib/scan.lgo --
package scanlib

import (
	"comptime"
	"errors"
)

func ScanField[F any](dst *F, path string) error {
	const switch F {
	case ~string:
		_ = &NotNullDest[F]{Dst: dst, Path: path}
		return nil
	}
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		return errors.New("scanlib: struct in minimal probe")
	}
	return errors.New("scanlib: " + path + ": unsupported type")
}

type NotNullDest[V any] struct {
	Dst  *V
	Path string
}

func IntField[F any](v F) string {
	const switch F {
	case int:
		var x F = v
		_ = x
		return "int"
	}
	const if comptime.IsStruct[F]() {
		return "struct"
	}
	return "other"
}

-- w/main/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/copyshadow/scanlib"
)

type Status string

func main() {
	var s Status
	if err := scanlib.ScanField[Status](&s, "s"); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("scan", scanlib.IntField[Status]("x"), scanlib.IntField[int](1))
}

-- w/scanlib/ext_test.lgo --
package scanlib_test

import (
	"testing"

	"example.com/copyshadow/scanlib"
)

type Status string

func TestDirectNamedCall(t *testing.T) {
	var s Status
	if err := scanlib.ScanField[Status](&s, "s"); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("ScanField: %v", err)
	}
	if got := scanlib.IntField[Status]("x"); got != "other" {
		t.Fatalf("IntField[Status] = %q, want other", got)
	}
	if got := scanlib.IntField[int](1); got != "int" {
		t.Fatalf("IntField[int] = %q, want int", got)
	}
}
